texts.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
texts.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind these singular phenomena?

sections.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
sections.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind these singular phenomena?

texts.zh:
驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
texts.en:
Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area rich in unusual minerals.

Similar occurrences have also been reported on worlds overseen by our colleagues in the [from.Federation.GetName]. They have responded by forming a committee led by [event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName], there to co-ordinate any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

texts.zh:
驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们让我们领导委员会，协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
texts.en:
Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area rich in unusual minerals.

Similar occurrences have also been reported on worlds overseen by our colleagues in the [from.Federation.GetName]. They have responded by tasking us with leadership of a committee, coordinating any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.zh:
我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事报告称听到了震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声，他认为声音的来源应该在地表之下，至少存在于一个星球中。他们成立了一个研究委员会，旨在支持他们的挖掘工作。

他们要求我们提供自己的额外资源，以便我们能够更好地理解这件奇怪的麻烦事。
texts.en:
Our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] report a deafening hum from sources thought to lie buried on at least one of their worlds. A research committee has been established to support any excavation efforts they make.

We have been asked to provide our own, additional resources, in order that we might all better understand this strange and inconvenient occurrence.

label.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
label.en: We will lend what support we can.
We don't have time for this.

texts.zh:
我们未能向同事提供他们要求的额外隔音罩。好在设备匮乏只会阻碍他们的工作，并不会彻底阻止他们挖掘。但是，这还是让一线研究人员更加不安。纵使报告显示噪音现在正自己减弱，他们的情绪也没有任何好转。

[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会现在邀请我们研究声音本身，看看能否得到些许启发，以此来弥补我们之前的过失。
texts.en:
We have failed to provide our colleagues with the additional acoustic shielding they had requested. This lack of equipment will only hamper their efforts, and won't stall them outright. Nevertheless, it has left their front-line researchers that bit more rattled, even after reports which suggest that the noise is now subsiding of its own accord.

The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee now invites us to make amends by contributing to a study of the sound itself, to see if that may shed any light.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.zh: 我们已成功提高了折叠隔音罩的覆盖范围和适应力，并与[root.Federation.GetName]的同事共享了这些升级成果。他们的一线研究员报告称意识不清和身体剧痛的情况已经有了极大改善。协调委员会现在要求我们协助进行数据分析。
texts.en: We have succeeded in improving the reach and resilience of our deployable acoustic shields. These upgrades have been shared with our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName]; their researchers on the ground already report a steep decline in cognitive distress and deep-body aching. The co-ordination committee now asks us to assist with a matter of data analysis.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.zh: 我们未能得出令人满意的成果，[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会对此表示失望。困扰联邦内多个星球的噪音终于消失，但研究机会的窗口也随之关闭。研究人员尽自己所能收集了一些信息，但现在只能寄希望于现场的考古学家能够给出详细的答案。
texts.en: The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee expresses its disappointment in our lack of results. As the din which has afflicted a number of our federated worlds finally dimmed, so too did the window of research opportunities close. Researchers gathered what insights they could, but any hope for detailed answers now rests solely with the archaeologists on the ground.

texts.zh: 联邦境内处考古遗址中的嗡鸣已经开始减弱。通过研究每种声音的录音，并将我们与同事的数据进行交叉对比，我们发现，当震耳欲聋的嗡鸣相互重叠时，会产生惊艳绝伦的和声，旋律可绕梁三日，令人心旷神怡。对于建造这些遗址的人来说，这种设计可能具有文化意义，但我们可能永远无法了解其中的含义。研究仍在继续……
texts.en: The humming at archaeological sites across our federation's space has begun to subside. By studying recordings of each sound - and cross-referencing our data with that of our colleagues - we discovered a surprising harmony as each deafening blast overlaps to form a more pleasant, ambient melody. It's possible that this arrangement held cultural significance for whoever developed these sites; we may never know. The research continues...

title.zh: 声震屋瓦的贝壳形建筑

texts.zh:
尽管我们必须断断续续地轮班工作，但从技术上讲，揭开这个遗址的奥秘非常简单。我们挖开了两层平平无奇的岩石，然后才看到一个大贝壳，也可以说是穹顶。此外，附近有一些相同的穹顶也已部分出土，目前看来，这些穹顶似乎排列成弧形或圆形。

每个穹顶都是用模子建成，并且进行过一定程度的加固，能够经受地质年代的考验。每个建筑都有会议室大小，因此应该能够进入其中。
texts.en:
The work of uncovering this site was technically straightforward - despite our having to work in staccato shifts. We removed two featureless strata before encountering a large shell or dome. Other, identical domes have been partially uncovered nearby; so far they seem to be arranged in an arc or circle.

Each dome was constructed from a mold, and was cured to such a degree that they have withstood geological ages. Ingress to these structures - each of which is the size of a gathering hall - should be possible.

texts.zh:
尽管我们尚未确定无处不在的嗡鸣的来源，但其主导地位已经开始有所减弱。自此以后，我们的研究人员就能够专注突破这座类似半球的建筑。

里面的空间完全没有实际内容，我们初步结论为，此建筑是按感官隔离室设计的。此外，穹顶的内表面似乎画有星座图，辅以神话人物和某种形式的经文。我们正在努力解读这些设计。
texts.en:
While we have yet to identify the source of the pervasive humming, its dominating presence has begun to wane. Our researchers were since able to focus on breaching the near-hemispherical structure.

The space within is entirely devoid of material contents; our initial conclusion is that this was designed as a sensory isolation chamber. Furthermore, the inside surface of the dome is illustrated with what appear to be constellation charts, supplemented by mythical figures and some form of scripture. We are already working to interpret these designs.

title.zh: 贝壳形建筑的内部结构

texts.zh:
我们在穹顶内部发现了大量精巧的设备，但没有一台能够产生我们在外面还能听到的巨大噪音。一支小规模的工作小队已经独立出去，继续我们的调查工作。

大部分研究人员还留在这个贝壳形结构中，研究其内部机制，设备结构复杂，装饰美观，乍一看像是某种大型计算器。
texts.en:
We discovered a plethora of elaborate equipment inside the dome, none of which seems capable of producing the immense noise we can still hear outside. A small task force has split off to continue that aspect of our investigation.

The bulk of our researchers remain within the shell-like structure, studying the mechanisms within. The equipment is intricate, decorative in form, and seems at first glance to be some form of vast calculator.

texts.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都确认：嗡鸣现已消失。尽管各星际遗址之间距离遥远，但嗡鸣声几乎在同一时间停止。

从那以后，我们的研究团队依据穹顶内部描绘的众多星座推断出了一些模型，这些星座通常用于占星预测。研究人员收集的数据表明，此设施，若是按年代排序，比周围地层要古老得多——但有一处明显的例外：研究人员偶然在穹顶外面发现了一个大型祭坛，这表明在相对较近的年代，至少有一个文明曾使用过这一空间。

祭台使用当地的石头凿成，上面雕有蚀刻图，我们认为这些蚀刻图是用来翻译穹顶上的古老星图，将其转化一个现今我们更为熟悉的星图。
texts.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the droning sirens have now dissipated. They ceased almost simultaneously, despite the vast distances between interstellar sites.

Since that time, our research team has extrapolated models from the many constellations depicted on the dome's interior, which seems to have been used to make astrological predictions. The data they've gathered suggests that this facility is far older than the surrounding strata, by an order of epochs - with one notable exception: the chance discovery of a large dais immediately outside the dome suggests that at least one civilization has used this space comparatively recently.

The dais was hewn from local stone, and is decorated with etchings we believe were used to translate the dome's outdated star charts for a galaxy arranged much as it is for us, now.

texts.zh:
来自[from.owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都表明：困扰我们共有空间各处研究遗址的嗡鸣声已经消失。这让我们的研究人员如释重负，因为他们可以开始研究穹顶内安置的复杂设备了。

尽管其设计古怪之极，但我们仍然辨认出，该设备由相互连接的太阳系仪组成。这些模型描绘了整个[from.system.GetName]星系和另外两个恒星系，但我们以及联邦内的同事至今仍不知道这两个星系的名称和位置。每台太阳系仪都由一组轴和齿轮驱动，支撑着无数由方解石和石化树液制成的雕塑。尽管看起来一动不动，但实际上它们正以缓慢的速度移动——就像巨大的星系时钟的一枝一节，而时钟的“钟声”可能就是我们先前听到的巨大嗡鸣。
texts.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the ringing hum which was plaguing research sites across our shared space has now dissipated. This came as relief to our researchers as they investigated the complex equipment arranged inside the dome.

Although its design is eccentric in the extreme, we've identified it as an arrangement of interlinked orreries. These models depict the entirety of [From.Planet.System.GetName] along with two other star systems, whose names and positions are not yet known - to us nor our federation colleagues. Each is driven by a nest of axles and gears, supporting myriad sculptures in calcite and fossilized sap. Although they appear quite still, they are actually moving at a glacial pace - like parts of a vast galactic timepiece, whose 'chimes' might be the great siren we heard earlier.

texts.zh:
我们对[from.Planet.GetName]和其他地方穹顶的研究已结束。每个遗址都是巨大的占星设备，跨越星际的距离与其他设备同步。

我们的研究表明，这类设施被视为宇宙能量的汇聚点，影响着建造设施的古老文明的总体“位置感”。蚀刻记录中提到，议会将“引导”这些能量，从而指引其帝国的命运。

他们的社会最终依然走向衰落，这种仪式并没有为其逆天改命。但在之后的一千年中，出现了一个继业的文明，这一继承者文明翻译并恢复了这一仪式。那之后，他们也离开了这些地方，不知去了何处。

这块巨大的时钟至少已经见证了两个文明的兴衰。现在，时钟的自动嗡鸣召唤着我们，让我们在太空区域各处见证这一仪式。无论是否会有确切结果，至少[from.owner.Federation.GetName]已经准备好进行观察了……
texts.en:
Our study of the domes on [From.Planet.GetName] and elsewhere has reached an end. Each site is a vast astrological device, synchronized with others like it across interstellar distances.

Our studies suggest that facilities like this one were treated as focal points for cosmic energy, affecting a general 'sense of place' for the ancient civilization which built them. Etched records speak of councils who would 'channel' these energies in order to guide their empire's fortunes.

Such observances did not halt their society's eventual decline, but in the millennia which followed there also came an inheritor who would translate and revive the practice. They too have since left these sites, for parts unknown.

The vast timepiece has slowly ticked on through the periods of at least two civilizations; its automated siren has now called on us to observe this ritual at sites across our region of space. Whether or not anything tangible results from it, the [from.owner.Federation.GetName] is now poised to observe...

texts.zh:
有人可能会说，我们直到最后一刻才收集完数据。联邦最新成果刚刚发布没几天，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几个圆顶遗址就突然活跃起来，一束束光从地下深处飞流直上，正好映照在我们首都上方，这让人难以置信。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。广播只传达了一个目的，即宣告这件事成为“求索的时刻”。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续缓慢地像时钟一样滴答地走过一个个时代，当然也包括我们当下的时代。
texts.en:
One might say that the last of our data was gathered in the nick of time. Mere days after the last of our federation's findings was published, each domed site within [from.Federation.GetName] space burst into life. Cascades of light spilled upwards from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. The broadcast 'spoke' with singular purpose, proclaiming this to be a 'Time of Knowing'.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their glacial 'ticking' through ages which now include our own.

texts.zh:
一刹那，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几座圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。尽管还不清楚广播的目的，但人们共同见证这一景象凸显出一种平衡繁荣的情感氛围。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续神秘而缓慢地像时钟一样滴答作响。
texts.en:
Each of the once-noisy, domed sites within [from.Federation.GetName] space has, for a brief moment, burst into life. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. It's unclear what the broadcast was intended for, but a commonly-shared observation highlights feelings of balanced prosperity.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their mysterious, glacial 'ticking'.

texts.zh:
整个[from.Federation.GetName]的智能生物都为眼前突然出现的宏伟景象所震惊。与此同时，几年前发现的古老圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员对这种梦幻般的景象感到非常困惑。目前我们还不清楚这一现象的目的，也没有观测到后续现象，因此无法获得更多线索。我们似乎错过了对其加以研究的时机。
texts.en:
Sapients throughout the [from.Federation.GetName] have been startled by a sudden, apparent hijacking of visual feeds which coincided with a burst of activity from ancient, domed sites discovered some years ago. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers on [root.Capital.GetName] are puzzled by this broadcast of dreamlike visions. It's unclear what it was intended for, and no subsequent phenomena have been reported which might lend us more clues. It would seem that we have simply missed an opportunity to study this phenomenon.

texts.zh: 我们的联邦境内，至少有一颗行星发出震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声。由于我们的同事正在努力挖掘这一遗迹，他们要求我们提供自己的科学资源支持其工作。
texts.en: A deafening hum rings out across at least one planet in our federation's space. As our colleagues work to excavate these sites, we have been asked to lend our own scientific resources to the effort.

texts.zh: 我们的联邦同事正在极度嘈杂的环境中努力进行挖掘工作，为协助他们，我们的任务是改进所有人的隔音罩。考古学家目前只能断断续续地轮班，暂时还没有出现身体不适的迹象。
texts.en: In order to assist our federation colleagues amidst exceedingly noisy conditions, we have been tasked with refining their personnel's acoustic shields. The archaeologists are currently unable to work anything more than staccato shifts before they show signs of physical distress.

texts.zh: 我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事已经开始进行下一阶段的挖掘工作，但是每个受影响的星球仍然会发出噪音，因此项目监督委员会委托我们研究这些逐渐减弱的噪音。
texts.en: Now that our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] have begun the next stage of their excavations, the project's oversight committee has delegated us to study the waning din which still emanates from each affected world.
